**Outcome:** No code defects at `5878a55f`, but the kernel test fails, contrary to the [latest reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12174#issuecomment-5876180673).

### Kernel migration test still fails after the rebase

`omarchy-kernel-migration-test.sh` exits 1 at head and base: its fake pacman mishandles the `--` from #11495. The description's "passes with the rename" fits only the old base `45748a28`.

**Suggested change:** tie that sentence to `45748a28`; optionally note the test needs a `--`-aware fake pacman (e.g. #13365).

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 5878a55f)</summary>

Run in a checkout of the PR head `5878a55f` (Arch/Omarchy, bash 5.3, GNU grep 3.12). The first two runs are the head as is; the `sed` only makes the test print the migration output and call log it otherwise deletes on exit. Keep `</dev/null`: with stdin left open, the unfixed fake pacman's `grep` waits on stdin instead of failing. The last run is the same head with #13365 merged (`git fetch origin pull/13365/head && git merge --no-edit FETCH_HEAD`). The base `b18ab495` gives the same `exit=1` as the head.

```text
$ bash test/shell.d/omarchy-kernel-migration-test.sh </dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
exit=1

$ sed -i "s|^trap 'rm -rf \"\$scratch\"' EXIT|trap 'cat \"\$scratch/output\" \"\$CALL_LOG\"; rm -rf \"\$scratch\"' EXIT|" test/shell.d/omarchy-kernel-migration-test.sh
$ bash test/shell.d/omarchy-kernel-migration-test.sh </dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
Install the Omarchy kernel and make it the first Limine boot entry
```

**Earlier findings** ([previous review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12174#issuecomment-5861727775)):
- #12173 fix: still verified.
- Re-run wording: resolved in the description; the reply's "no-op" misses re-trusted custom configs.

- ID helper: tracked in #13516, #13626, #13656.

<details><summary>Reproducer: re-run revokes a re-trusted custom config (5878a55f)</summary>

Run from the root of a checkout of the PR head `5878a55f`. The account already holds a `1789095456.sh` marker (the cleanup ran under the old id) and has a custom `~/Work/.mise.toml` it trusted again afterwards. Only the renamed migration is installed in the temporary `OMARCHY_PATH`.

```text
$ mise --version
2026.9.14 linux-x64 (2026-09-25)
$ cat repro.sh
home=$(mktemp -d); omarchy=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$omarchy/migrations" "$home/Work" "$home/.local/state/omarchy/migrations"
cp migrations/1789584463.sh "$omarchy/migrations/"
run() { env -i HOME="$home" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$home/.cache" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$home/.config" \
  XDG_DATA_HOME="$home/.local/share" XDG_STATE_HOME="$home/.local/state" \
  OMARCHY_PATH="$omarchy" PATH="$PWD/bin:/usr/bin" "$@"; }
touch "$home/.local/state/omarchy/migrations/1789095456.sh"  # cleanup already ran under the old id
printf '[env]\nKEEP = "yes"\n' > "$home/Work/.mise.toml"      # custom Work config written afterwards
run mise trust "$home/Work/.mise.toml"                         # re-trusted, as the first run's message invites
echo "before: $(cd "$home/Work" && run mise env -s bash 2>&1 | grep KEEP)"
run bin/omarchy-migrate --pending
run bin/omarchy-migrate
echo "after: $(cd "$home/Work" && run mise env -s bash 2>&1 | grep -e KEEP -e 'not trusted')"
$ bash repro.sh; echo "exit=$?"
mise trusted ~/Work
before: export KEEP=yes
1789584463.sh

Running migration (1789584463)
Remove automatic project bin directories from PATH
mise untrusted ~/Work

Mise trust for this custom config was revoked. Review it before trusting it again:
  mise trust /tmp/tmp.2O2cshClA3/Work/.mise.toml
after: mise ERROR Config files in ~/Work/.mise.toml are not trusted.
exit=0
```
</details>

- `git range-diff` shows the rebased commit equal to `72c37a91`; the renamed migration is the same blob as `migrations/1789095456.sh` on `quattro`.
- `quattro` after `b18ab495` changes nothing relevant. No other branch, tag or open PR head uses `1789584463`.
- With a PTL-era marker, `b421b1b4` skips the cleanup and keeps a trusted stock Work config. `quattro` plus this PR runs `1789584463.sh` and removes it.
- `mise-work-path-test.sh` passes at head. The head merges cleanly into `b421b1b4`.
- With this PR merged, #11322 merges cleanly, and `omarchy-migrate --pending` omits its `1789095456.sh` when that marker exists.
</details>
